orange-cap.title: Orange cap — most runs
orange-cap.description: Top run-scorers across all captured MLC matches. The MLC equivalent of the IPL Orange Cap.
orange-cap.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor; all qualifying appearances included.

purple-cap.title: Purple cap — most wickets
purple-cap.description: Top wicket-takers across all captured MLC matches.
purple-cap.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor; all qualifying appearances included.

strike-rate.title: Highest batting strike rates
strike-rate.description: Best batting strike rates with a minimum sample floor.

economy-leaders.title: Best bowling economy rates
economy-leaders.description: Lowest bowling economy rates with a minimum sample floor.

most-sixes.title: Most sixes
most-sixes.description: Top six-hitters across captured MLC matches.
most-sixes.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor; all qualifying appearances included.

most-fours.title: Most fours
most-fours.description: Top boundary-hitters across captured MLC matches.
most-fours.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor; all qualifying appearances included.

top-knocks.title: Highest individual scores
top-knocks.description: Highest individual innings scores across captured MLC matches.
top-knocks.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor; all qualifying appearances included.

best-bowling.title: Best bowling — wicket leaders
best-bowling.description: Wicket totals across captured MLC matches. Per-innings figures available on player profiles.
best-bowling.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor; all qualifying appearances included.

most-ducks.title: Most ducks
most-ducks.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor; all qualifying appearances included.

single-digit-outs.title: Most single-digit outs
single-digit-outs.description: Most times dismissed for fewer than 10 runs.
single-digit-outs.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor; all qualifying appearances included.

powerplay-strike-rate.title: Highest powerplay strike rates
powerplay-strike-rate.description: Best batting strike rates in the powerplay (overs 1–6 of a T20 innings).

death-overs-economy.title: Best death-overs economy
death-overs-economy.description: Lowest bowling economy rates in death overs (overs 17–20 of a T20 innings).
death-overs-economy.floorNote: Minimum 15 legal deliveries bowled in overs 17–20.

death-overs-strike-rate.title: Highest death-overs strike rates
death-overs-strike-rate.description: Best batting strike rates in death overs (overs 17–20).

powerplay-economy.title: Best powerplay economy
powerplay-economy.description: Lowest bowling economy rates in the powerplay (overs 1–6).
powerplay-economy.floorNote: Minimum 18 legal deliveries bowled in overs 1–6.

batting-average.title: Best batting averages
batting-average.description: Highest batting averages across captured MLC matches (runs per dismissal).

bowling-average.title: Best bowling averages
bowling-average.description: Lowest bowling averages across captured MLC matches (runs per wicket).

bowling-strike-rate.title: Best bowling strike rates
bowling-strike-rate.description: Fewest balls per wicket (lower is better) across captured MLC matches.

most-runs-conceded.title: Most runs conceded
most-runs-conceded.description: Bowlers who conceded the most runs — high-volume context metric.
most-runs-conceded.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor.

pp-runs.title: Most powerplay runs scored
pp-runs.description: Top run-scorers in the powerplay (overs 1–6) across captured MLC matches.

death-runs.title: Most death-overs runs scored
death-runs.description: Top run-scorers in death overs (overs 17–20) across captured MLC matches.

pp-wickets.title: Most powerplay wickets taken
pp-wickets.description: Top wicket-takers in the powerplay (overs 1–6) across captured MLC matches.

death-wickets.title: Most death-overs wickets taken
death-wickets.description: Top wicket-takers in death overs (overs 17–20) across captured MLC matches.

most-sixes-pp.title: Most powerplay sixes
most-sixes-pp.description: Most sixes hit in the powerplay (overs 1–6) across captured MLC matches.

most-sixes-death.title: Most death-overs sixes
most-sixes-death.description: Most sixes hit in death overs (overs 17–20) across captured MLC matches.

most-fours-pp.title: Most powerplay fours
most-fours-pp.description: Most fours hit in the powerplay (overs 1–6) across captured MLC matches.

most-fours-death.title: Most death-overs fours
most-fours-death.description: Most fours hit in death overs (overs 17–20) across captured MLC matches.

most-not-outs.title: Most not-outs
most-not-outs.description: Batters who finished unbeaten most often — a marker of finishers and middle-order anchors.
most-not-outs.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor.

most-innings.title: Most innings batted
most-innings.description: Most innings batted across all captured MLC matches. A volume metric for high-frequency batters.
most-innings.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor.

most-appearances.title: Most matches played
most-appearances.description: Most MLC matches played — the all-time appearance leaders across 2023–2025.
most-appearances.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor.

most-boundaries.title: Most boundaries (4s + 6s)
most-boundaries.description: Total boundaries (fours plus sixes combined) across all captured MLC matches.
most-boundaries.floorNote: Counting stat — no minimum sample floor.

most-boundaries-pp.title: Most powerplay boundaries
most-boundaries-pp.description: Most boundaries (fours + sixes) hit in the powerplay (overs 1–6) across captured MLC matches.
most-boundaries-pp.floorNote: Counting stat — all powerplay appearances included.

most-boundaries-death.title: Most death-overs boundaries
most-boundaries-death.description: Most boundaries (fours + sixes) hit in death overs (overs 17–20) across captured MLC matches.
most-boundaries-death.floorNote: Counting stat — all death-over appearances included.

pp-bowling-strike-rate.title: Best powerplay bowling strike rate
pp-bowling-strike-rate.description: Fewest balls per wicket in the powerplay (overs 1–6). Lower values are better.
pp-bowling-strike-rate.floorNote: Minimum 18 legal deliveries in the powerplay with at least 1 wicket.

death-bowling-strike-rate.title: Best death-overs bowling strike rate
death-bowling-strike-rate.description: Fewest balls per wicket in death overs (overs 17–20). Lower values are better.
death-bowling-strike-rate.floorNote: Minimum 12 legal deliveries in death overs with at least 1 wicket.

most-pp-overs-bowled.title: Most powerplay balls bowled
most-pp-overs-bowled.description: Total legal deliveries bowled in the powerplay — identifies the highest-usage PP attack bowlers.

most-death-overs-bowled.title: Most death-overs balls bowled
most-death-overs-bowled.description: Total legal deliveries bowled in death overs — identifies the most-used death bowlers.

most-fifties.title: Most fifties
most-fifties.description: Most innings scoring 50–99 runs across all captured MLC matches.
most-fifties.floorNote: All innings included — minimum 1 fifty to appear.

most-hundreds.title: Most hundreds
most-hundreds.description: Most innings scoring ≥100 runs across all captured MLC matches.
most-hundreds.floorNote: All innings included — minimum 1 century to appear.

most-dot-balls.title: Most dot balls bowled
most-dot-balls.description: Most legal deliveries conceding 0 total runs, indicating control and pressure ability.

middle-runs.title: Most middle-overs runs
middle-runs.description: Most runs scored in the middle overs (overs 6–15) across all captured MLC matches.
middle-runs.floorNote: Minimum 20 balls faced in middle overs.

middle-economy.title: Best middle-overs economy
middle-economy.description: Fewest runs conceded per over in the middle overs (overs 6–15). Lower is better.
middle-economy.floorNote: Minimum 18 legal deliveries in middle overs.

middle-sixes.title: Most middle-overs sixes
middle-sixes.description: Most sixes hit in the middle overs (overs 6–15) across all captured MLC matches.
middle-sixes.floorNote: Minimum 20 balls faced in middle overs.

middle-wickets.title: Most middle-overs wickets
middle-wickets.description: Most wickets taken in the middle overs (overs 6–15) across all captured MLC matches.
middle-wickets.floorNote: Minimum 18 legal deliveries in middle overs with at least 1 wicket.

fastest-fifty.title: Fastest fifties
fastest-fifty.description: Fewest balls needed to score 50 in an MLC innings. Ascending by balls faced.

fastest-hundred.title: Fastest hundreds
fastest-hundred.description: Fewest balls needed to score 100 in an MLC innings. Ascending by balls faced.

most-maidens.title: Most maiden overs
most-maidens.description: Most over-length (6-ball) overs with a single bowler conceding zero runs across all captured MLC matches.

hat-tricks.title: Hat-tricks
hat-tricks.description: Three or more consecutive bowler-credited wickets in an innings across all captured MLC matches.

dot-ball-pct.title: Highest dot-ball percentage
dot-ball-pct.description: Bowlers who delivered the highest proportion of dot balls (0 runs off the bat) across captured MLC matches. Measures control and pressure-building ability.

boundary-dependency.title: Highest boundary dependency
boundary-dependency.description: Batters who scored the highest proportion of their runs through boundaries (fours and sixes). Indicates reliance on hitting over running between wickets.

century-rate.title: Best century rate
century-rate.description: Batters who convert innings into centuries most often — hundreds per innings as a percentage. Identifies elite match-winners.

partnership-stands.title: Highest partnership stands
partnership-stands.description: Largest batting partnerships (runs scored between consecutive wicket falls) across all MLC matches. Derived from ball-by-ball data — every stand is traceable to a specific match.

opening-stands.title: Highest opening partnerships
opening-stands.description: Largest 1st-wicket opening partnerships in MLC history. Opening stand size is one of the strongest predictors of winning the match in T20 cricket.

partnership-run-rate.title: Fastest partnerships by run rate
partnership-run-rate.description: Batting pairs with the highest scoring rate in a single partnership stand across MLC matches. Minimum 18 balls in the partnership.

2nd-wicket-stands.title: Highest 2nd wicket partnerships
2nd-wicket-stands.description: Largest partnerships for the 2nd wicket in MLC — the key consolidation stand after the first wicket falls.

3rd-wicket-stands.title: Highest 3rd wicket partnerships
3rd-wicket-stands.description: Largest 3rd wicket batting partnerships in MLC history — the middle-order anchor stand.
